baselineProfile.qualification: Starting published code; CPU profiler plus read-only observation. Read-only ceiling throws at S2 300 s; no final engine result. Partial ledger is not an exhaustion certificate.

contraproofs.preparedRoundDomain: Rejected before ASST: direct canonical placement and prepared interval eligibility differed with asymmetric participant margins. Final cache stores canPlaceTask results, never substitutes interval acceptance.
contraproofs.zeroRoundProbe: Refuted: a zero macro estimate records diagnostics but still invokes exploreExactRoundSynchronizationPolicy and its alternative matchings; no zero-estimate branch prune.
contraproofs.repeatedPrerequisites: Core 9 cycle 1 observes 804 prerequisite contexts, all unique. Fixed-root cache reuses placement computations, not full search outcomes.
contraproofs.fixedOutOnly: Discarded: local control c3 546.937->456.372 ms, c6 392.206->399.962 ms; no consistent benefit or S2 certificate.
contraproofs.fixedRootReplayQualification: Observed core 3/6 source and immutable roots; ten additional contexts per root are synthetic perturbations using pending tasks. These are equivalence/cost controls, not recorded solver candidates or S2 certificates.

remainingBlocker.qualification: Read-only replay of core 9 supporting prerequisite producer. Branch-local Hall only; no S2 certificate or global infeasibility.
remainingBlocker.serializationQualification: JSON serializes infinite necessary release bounds as null. The replay compares serialized diagnostics; original full canonical and cached results were deepEqual before serialization.
